launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.2.1 'Glide': fixes the PojavLauncher startup crash (the AA renderer is now written GLES2-safe, mobile GL renders the same silky UI without crashing) and fixes typing '@' in any input field opening a broadcast/unavailable screen (the vanilla 1.8.9 Twitch keybinds are neutralized - their default was literally keycode 64 = '@'). The non-classic mod menu Settings tab now lists EVERY client setting grouped by category (Style/Misc/Performance/Controls) with checkbox, slider, dropdown, color and keybind widgets, plus a new 'Centered Mod Menu' option (ON by default) that opens the menu as a Badlion-style centered window, and a 'Smooth UI' switch as a safe fallback for exotic drivers.
